clips.intro: Welcome to the English phrases practice. Listen carefully and choose or complete each answer. Good luck!
clips.l1: Nina saves half of her pocket money every week. She wants to buy a birthday present for her mother.
clips.l2: Walking every day is good for your health. You can walk to school with your friends.
clips.l3: This beautiful lake covers an area of two square kilometres.
clips.l4: The invention helps us solve a problem. It gives food to our pets when we are away.
clips.l5: Your temperature is high. You have a fever. Please drink some water and get some rest.
clips.l6: We are travelling around the country. We see different views every day.
